description: This file contains unit tests for the vCal class within the SuiteCRM project. It tests various functionalities related to calendar event manipulations and iCalendar formatting.

classes.name: vCalTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that verifies functionality of the vCal class in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets up a new 'Users' bean as current user.

methods.name: testvCal
methods.description: Tests constructor of vCal object for correct instantiation and attribute values.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Verifies the behavior of get_summary_text method with and without the name property set.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Ensures fill_in_additional_list_fields executes without exception (method unimplemented).

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Ensures fill_in_additional_detail_fields executes without exception (method unimplemented).

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Checks get_list_view_data method executes without exception (method unimplemented).

methods.name: testget_freebusy_lines_cache
methods.description: Validates the format of get_freebusy_lines_cache output, checking start and end strings.

methods.name: testcreate_sugar_freebusy
methods.description: Tests create_sugar_freebusy method with current, yesterday, and tomorrow times.

methods.name: testget_vcal_freebusy
methods.description: Verifies the output of get_vcal_freebusy method includes expected VFREEBUSY start and end strings.

methods.name: testcache_sugar_vcal
methods.description: Tests the cache_sugar_vcal static method for execution without exceptions.

methods.name: testcache_sugar_vcal_freebusy
methods.description: Tests the cache_sugar_vcal_freebusy static method for execution without exceptions.

methods.name: testfold_ical_lines
methods.description: Checks folding of ical lines with short and long strings, ensuring formatting complies.

methods.name: testcreate_ical_array_from_string
methods.description: Verifies parsing of a calendar string into an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: testcreate_ical_string_from_array
methods.description: Validates creation of an iCalendar string from an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: testescape_ical_chars
methods.description: Tests escaping of special characters in iCalendar format.

methods.name: testunescape_ical_chars
methods.description: Tests unescaping of special characters back to normal from iCalendar format.

methods.name: testget_ical_event
methods.description: Checks the generation of an iCal VEVENT string from a meeting and user.
